messages:
ivy-h: follow-up from postmortem: vendor maintenance + high-rate deploys produced token throttling that caused model-registry write errors and a deployment backlog. this is the 3rd auth-related incident in ~6 months. we sketched options in the doc; need concrete owners and deadlines. posting a short actionable list. please ack and claim.

oscar-l: quick recap/times: incident began 2025-11-12T02:18Z, degraded 02:22, manual mitigations started 02:35, service steady 02:52. symptoms: token-error spikes (~14%), write 5xxs, retries piled up.

oncall-max: ops note: reads largely worked; writes caused DB pressure until we paused retries and drained a temp queue. we also disabled bulk deploys mid-incident.

ivy-h: proposed actions (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor maintenance visibility & contract ask (48h advance notice) -> owner: contracts-rita -> ETA: 10d
- dual-issuer token failover prototype (health probe + switch) -> owner: oscar-l -> ETA: 3w
- short-lived local write-queue + idempotent background apply -> owner: oscar-l -> ETA: 10d
- SDK protections: cached-token read-mode + bounded backoff + jitter for writes -> owner: oscar-l -> ETA: 5d
- alerting: composite alert for token-error-rate >5% over 5m + registry-write-fail spike -> owner: oncall-max -> ETA: 48h
- deploy pipeline gate: block/slow big batches during vendor maintenance windows -> owner: oncall-max -> ETA: EOW
- monthly dependency review to track recurrence -> owner: ivy-h -> ETA: create recurring now

oscar-l: I'll take failover + SDK + write-queue. plan: SDK quick fix PR tomorrow, queue prototype in 1w, failover probe doc by EOW, prototype probe in 3w.

contracts-rita: taking vendor escalation. will ask for maintenance calendar and better advance-notice terms. pinging account rep now. ETA 10d for reply.

oncall-max: will add the composite alert and pipeline gate. setting up dashboard tiles tonight.

ops-bot: created INC-9200 - "auth-dep: maintenance-surge mitigations" assigned to oscar-l, oncall-max, contracts-rita. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9200

ivy-h: small code sketch for the local queue behavior (pseudocode):

```
if (auth_error && queue.enabled) {
  enqueue(write_request);
  return 202; // accepted, will apply when tokens healthy
} else {
  attempt_write_with_backoff();
}
```

oscar-l: note: queue must be idempotent and bounded; will add metrics for queue depth and max hold time.

ivy-h: prioritization note: given recurrence, make dual-issuer failover P0 and vendor-contract visibility P0. sdk + queue = P1 quick wins. any objections?

oncall-max: ack. no objections.

contracts-rita: ack; escalating now.

oscar-l: ack. will post PR links to INC-9200 and update timelines if blockers show up.

ivy-h: scheduling a 15m sync Mon 09:00 to confirm blockers and initial PRs. update INC-9200 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
